title: Open a folder
subtitle: {count} things to know before the folder picker opens.
bulletAnyFolder: Any markdown folder works: no special format required.
bulletLocal: Atlas opens this folder locally and does not upload it to an Atlas backend. A coding agent you later connect may send prompts and context to its own provider.
bulletStarter: Pick an empty folder and Atlas adds starter documents.
bulletPermission: After you pick, the browser asks you to Allow. That grants this page local file access; it is separate from any coding agent connection.
actionCreateNew: Start fresh with an empty folder
